# baffinbay_l4_proxy (Resource)

Manages a Baffin Bay L4 Proxy traffic configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend` (Attributes) The L4 backend configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backend))
- `frontend` (Attributes) The L4 frontend configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--frontend))
- `name` (String) The name of the L4 Proxy traffic configuration.

### Optional

- `deployment_state` (String) The deployment state (DEPLOYED, UNDEPLOYED).
- `ip_based_access_control` (Attributes) Controls L4 source IP based access control. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_based_access_control))
- `protocols` (List of String) The L4 protocols to proxy (TCP, UDP).
- `proxy_protocol` (String) Controls the L4 proxy protocol setting (ENABLED, DISABLED).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the L4 Proxy traffic configuration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import baffinbay_l4_proxy.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```

When using Terraform config generation, Terraform may emit `provider = threat-protection` because the registry source is `baffinbay/threat-protection`. If your `required_providers` block uses the normal local name `baffinbay`, remove that generated line or change it to `provider = baffinbay` before applying the generated configuration.
